name: create_event
description:
Creates a new event with all standard Salespower Event fields.

This function validates input using the EventInput Pydantic model, performs referential integrity checks on ID fields, generates system fields (Id, CreatedDate, SystemModstamp), auto-calculates DurationInMinutes if not provided, and stores the event in the database.

Recurrence Rules:
When creating recurring events, the following validation rules apply:

General Consistency Rules:
- If IsRecurrence is True, RecurrenceType must be provided (minimum requirement).
- If any recurrence field is provided (RecurrenceType, RecurrenceInterval, RecurrenceEndDateOnly, RecurrenceMonthOfYear, RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask, RecurrenceDayOfMonth, or RecurrenceInstance), IsRecurrence must be set to True.
- If RecurrenceType is provided, IsRecurrence must be set to True.

RecurrenceType-Specific Required Fields:
- RecursDaily (daily recurrence): RecurrenceInterval (required, positive integer specifying interval in days), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required, YYYY-MM-DD format).
- RecursWeekly (weekly recurrence): RecurrenceInterval (required, positive integer specifying interval in weeks), RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask (required, bitmask: Sunday=1, Monday=2, Tuesday=4, Wednesday=8, Thursday=16, Friday=32, Saturday=64), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).
- RecursMonthly (monthly on specific day): RecurrenceInterval (required, positive integer specifying interval in months), RecurrenceDayOfMonth (required, 1-31), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).
- RecursMonthlyNth (monthly on Nth weekday, e.g., "second Tuesday"): RecurrenceInterval (required), RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask (required), RecurrenceInstance (required, First/Second/Third/Fourth/Last), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).
- RecursYearly (yearly on specific date): RecurrenceMonthOfYear (required, 1-12), RecurrenceDayOfMonth (required, 1-31), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).
- RecursYearlyNth (yearly on Nth weekday of month, e.g., "third Monday of March"): RecurrenceMonthOfYear (required, 1-12), RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask (required), RecurrenceInstance (required), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).

Name.description: The name of the event (maximum 255 characters).

StartDateTime.description: Start time of the event in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z').

EndDateTime.description: End time of the event in ISO 8601 format. Must be >= StartDateTime.

IsAllDayEvent.description: Whether the event is all day. If True, ActivityDate must be provided.

OwnerId.description: ID of the event owner (a non-empty fixture-compatible identifier using letters and digits with internal hyphens or underscores). Must exist in User collection.

WhoId.description: ID of the related contact or lead (a non-empty fixture-compatible identifier using letters and digits with internal hyphens or underscores). Must exist in Contact or Lead collection.

WhatId.description: ID of the related record (a non-empty fixture-compatible identifier using letters and digits with internal hyphens or underscores). Must exist in Account, Opportunity, or Event collection.

ActivityDate.description: Date of the activity in YYYY-MM-DD format (required for all-day events).

ActivityDateTime.description: Date and time of the activity in ISO 8601 format.

DurationInMinutes.description: Duration of the event in minutes. If not provided and both StartDateTime and EndDateTime are provided, this will be auto-calculated. If provided, must match the calculated duration between StartDateTime and EndDateTime.

ShowAs.description: How the event appears in calendar. Valid values: Busy, Free, OutOfOffice, Tentative (case-sensitive).

Type.description: Type of the event. Valid values: Meeting, Call, Email, Other (case-sensitive).

IsChild.description: Whether this is a child event.

IsGroupEvent.description: Whether this is a group event. If True, GroupEventType must be provided.

GroupEventType.description: Type of group event. Valid values: Group0, Group1 (case-sensitive). Required if IsGroupEvent is True. If provided, IsGroupEvent must be True.

IsRecurrence.description: Whether the event is recurring. If True, RecurrenceType must be provided.

RecurrenceType.description: Type of recurrence pattern. Valid values: RecursDaily, RecursWeekly, RecursMonthly, RecursMonthlyNth, RecursYearly, RecursYearlyNth (case-sensitive). Required if IsRecurrence is True. If provided, IsRecurrence must be True.

RecurrenceInterval.description: Interval between recurring event instances (e.g., 2 for every 2 weeks). Must be a positive integer. Required for RecursDaily, RecursWeekly, RecursMonthly, RecursMonthlyNth.

RecurrenceEndDateOnly.description: End date for the recurrence series in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required for all recurrence types.

RecurrenceMonthOfYear.description: Month of year for recurrence (1-12). Required for RecursYearly, RecursYearlyNth.

RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask.description: Day of week mask for recurrence (bitmask representing days). Required for RecursWeekly, RecursMonthlyNth, RecursYearlyNth.

RecurrenceDayOfMonth.description: Day of month for recurrence (1-31). Required for RecursMonthly, RecursYearly.

RecurrenceInstance.description: Recurrence instance specification. Valid values: First, Second, Third, Fourth, Last (case-sensitive). Required for RecursMonthlyNth, RecursYearlyNth.

IsReminderSet.description: Whether reminder is set. If True, ReminderDateTime must be provided.

ReminderDateTime.description: Reminder date and time in ISO 8601 format. Required if IsReminderSet is True. If provided, IsReminderSet must be True.

name: create_task
description:
Creates a new task with all standard Salespower Task fields and comprehensive validation.

This function implements strict validation including semantic consistency checks,
input sanitization, referential integrity validation, and prevention of contradictory states.

Priority.description: Priority of the task (required). Must be one of: "High", "Normal", "Low".

Status.description: Status of the task (required). Must be one of: "Not Started", "In Progress", "Completed", "Waiting", "Deferred", "Open", "Closed".

Name.description: The name of the task. Must be at least 1 character if provided. Maximum length: 80 characters.

Subject.description: The subject of the task. Must be at least 1 character if provided. Maximum length: 255 characters.

Description.description: Description of the task. Must be at least 1 character if provided. Maximum length: 32,000 characters.

ActivityDate.description: Due date of the task in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

DueDate.description: Alternative field for task due date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

OwnerId.description: ID of the task owner. Must be a non-empty fixture-compatible identifier using letters and digits with internal hyphens or underscores if provided.

WhoId.description: ID of the related contact. Must be a non-empty fixture-compatible identifier using letters and digits with internal hyphens or underscores if provided. Referential integrity checked.

WhatId.description: ID of the related record. Must be a non-empty fixture-compatible identifier using letters and digits with internal hyphens or underscores if provided. Referential integrity checked.

ReminderDateTime.description: Reminder date and time in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS).

CallDurationInSeconds.description: Duration of call in seconds. Must be non-negative.

CallDisposition.description: Free-text outcome recorded for a call task.

RecurrenceType.description: Type of recurrence pattern. Valid values: RecursDaily, RecursWeekly, RecursMonthly, RecursMonthlyNth, RecursYearly, RecursYearlyNth (case-sensitive). Required if IsRecurrence is True.

RecurrenceInterval.description: Recurrence interval. Must be positive if provided.

RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask.description: Day of week mask for recurrence.

RecurrenceInstance.description: Recurrence instance specification. Valid values: First, Second, Third, Fourth, Last (case-sensitive).

CompletedDateTime.description: Date and time when task was completed. Must be consistent with Status.

IsClosed.description: Whether the task is closed. Must be consistent with Status.

IsHighPriority.description: Whether the task is high priority. Must be consistent with Priority.

TaskSubtype.description: Task subtype value recorded by Salespower or a fixture.

moved from the Event collection to the DeletedEvents collection, and its SystemModstamp is updated
to the deletion timestamp. The event can be restored using the undelete_event function.

name: delete_task
description:
Deletes a task from the Salespower system.

This function performs a soft delete operation on a task record. The task is:
1. Removed from the active Task collection
2. Moved to the DeletedTasks collection with deletion metadata
3. Marked with IsDeleted=True flag
4. Timestamped with SystemModstamp and deletedDate fields

Additionally, this function performs cascade deletes on related child records. All child records
with cascadeDelete=True relationships (as defined in the TaskSObject metadata) are also soft-deleted
and moved to their respective Deleted* collections. This ensures referential integrity is maintained.

The deleted task can be restored using the undelete_task function.
Deleted tasks are excluded from query and search operations but can be retrieved
using get_deleted_tasks() for data replication purposes.

task_id.description: Unique identifier of the task to delete (a non-empty fixture-compatible identifier using letters and digits with internal hyphens or underscores). The task must exist in the active Task collection. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

name: execute_soql_query
description:
Executes a SOQL-like query against the in-memory database.

The query string is first URL-decoded.
The parser has specific behaviors and improved parsing logic as detailed below.

q.description:
The SOQL-like query string. Examples:
- "SELECT Name, Location FROM Event WHERE Location = 'Boardroom' ORDER BY Name ASC OFFSET 0 LIMIT 5"
- "SELECT Id, Subject, Status FROM Task WHERE (Status = 'Completed' OR Status = 'Closed') AND Subject LIKE '%important%'"
- "SELECT Id, Subject, DueDate FROM Task WHERE DueDate = TODAY"
- "SELECT Id, Subject, DueDate FROM Task WHERE DueDate >= NEXT_N_DAYS:7"

name: get_deleted_events
description:
Retrieves the list of individual records that have been deleted within the given timespan for the specified object.

This function implements Salespower API getDeleted() for data replication applications to retrieve a list
of records that have been deleted from your organization's data within the specified timespan.

sObjectType.description: The type of object to retrieve deleted records for. Must be "Event" for this function.

start_date.description:
Starting date/time (UTC) of the timespan for which to retrieve the data.
Format: ISO 8601 (e.g., "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z").
The API ignores the seconds portion of the specified dateTime value.
If None, no start date filter is applied.

end_date.description:
Ending date/time (UTC) of the timespan for which to retrieve the data.
Format: ISO 8601 (e.g., "2024-01-31T23:59:00Z").
The API ignores the seconds portion of the specified dateTime value.
If None, no end date filter is applied.

name: get_deleted_tasks
description:
Retrieves the list of individual records that have been deleted within the given timespan for the specified object.

This function implements Salespower API getDeleted() for data replication applications to retrieve a list
of records that have been deleted from your organization's data within the specified timespan.

sObjectType.description: The type of object to retrieve deleted records for. Must be "Task".

start_date.description:
Starting date/time (UTC) of the timespan for which to retrieve the data.
Format: ISO 8601 (e.g., "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z").

end_date.description:

name: get_updated_events
description:
Retrieves updated events between start_date_time and end_date_time.

Retrieves updated events between start_date_time and end_date_time. The events are returned if the property SystemModstamp is between the provided dates (inclusive of start_date_time, exclusive of end_date_time).

start_date_time.description: Start time to look for updated events in ISO 8601 format (UTC). Must chronologically precede end_date_time. The boundary is inclusive (events with SystemModstamp >= start_date_time are included).

end_date_time.description: End time to look for updated events in ISO 8601 format (UTC). Must be after start_date_time. The boundary is exclusive (events with SystemModstamp < end_date_time are included).

name: get_updated_tasks
description:
Retrieves the list of individual Task records that have been updated (added or changed) or deleted within the given timespan.

This function is used to get the list of Task records that have been updated (added or changed) or deleted within the given timespan. The function includes both active tasks (from the Task collection) and deleted tasks (from the DeletedTasks collection) that were modified or deleted within the specified time range.

start_date.description: Starting date/time (UTC) of the timespan for which to retrieve the data. ISO 8601 format. Seconds are ignored.

end_date.description: Ending date/time (UTC) of the timespan for which to retrieve the data. ISO 8601 format. Seconds are ignored.

name: parse_where_clause_conditions
description:
Parse the conditions in the WHERE clause.

Handles '=', 'IN', 'NOT IN', 'LIKE', 'CONTAINS', '>', '<', 'IS NULL', and 'IS NOT NULL'.

Values are automatically converted to their appropriate types:
- Boolean literals ('true', 'false') are converted to bool
- Numeric strings are converted to int or float
- Other values remain as strings

Note: 'LIKE' and 'CONTAINS' operators keep values as strings (they are pattern matching operators).
Note: 'IS NULL' and 'IS NOT NULL' operators do not require a value and will set the value to None.

conditions.description:
List of condition strings to parse. Example:
- "Subject = 'Meeting'"
- "IsAllDayEvent = true"
- "Location IN ('Boardroom', 'Conference Room')"
- "Status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Closed')"
- "Description LIKE '%important%'"
- "Subject CONTAINS 'review'",
- "Priority < 'High'"

name: query_events
description: Query events based on specified criteria.

criteria.description: Key-value pairs to filter events. The default value is None. All keys are optional for flexible filtering. If criteria is None or an empty dict ({}), all non-deleted events are returned. Known filterable keys include: 'Subject' (Optional[str]): The subject of the event (case-insensitive comparison); 'IsAllDayEvent' (Optional[bool]): Whether the event is all day; 'StartDateTime' (Optional[str]): Start time of the event in ISO 8601 format (case-sensitive comparison); 'EndDateTime' (Optional[str]): End time of the event in ISO 8601 format (case-sensitive comparison); 'Description' (Optional[str]): Description of the event (case-insensitive comparison); 'Location' (Optional[str]): Location of the event (case-insensitive comparison); 'Name' (Optional[str]): Name of the event (case-insensitive comparison); 'OwnerId' (Optional[str]): ID of the event owner (case-sensitive comparison); 'WhoId' (Optional[str]): ID of the related contact or lead (case-sensitive comparison); 'WhatId' (Optional[str]): ID of the related account, opportunity, campaign, case, or contract (case-sensitive comparison); 'Id' (Optional[str]): Unique identifier for the event (case-sensitive comparison); 'CreatedDate' (Optional[str]): Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format (case-sensitive comparison); 'SystemModstamp' (Optional[str]): Last modification timestamp in ISO 8601 format (case-sensitive comparison); 'deletedDate' (Optional[str]): Deletion timestamp in ISO 8601 format (present only for deleted events, case-sensitive comparison); 'ActivityDate' (Optional[str]): Date of the activity in ISO 8601 format (case-sensitive comparison); 'ActivityDateTime' (Optional[str]): Activity date and time in ISO 8601 format (case-sensitive comparison); 'DurationInMinutes' (Optional[int]): Duration of the event in minutes; 'IsPrivate' (Optional[bool]): Whether the event is private; 'ShowAs' (Optional[str]): How the event appears in calendar. Valid values: Busy, Free, OutOfOffice, Tentative (case-sensitive); 'Type' (Optional[str]): Type of the event. Valid values: Meeting, Call, Email, Other (case-sensitive); 'IsChild' (Optional[bool]): Whether the event is a child event in a recurring series; 'IsGroupEvent' (Optional[bool]): Whether the event is a group event; 'GroupEventType' (Optional[str]): Type of group event. Valid values: Group0, Group1 (case-sensitive); 'IsRecurrence' (Optional[bool]): Whether the event is part of a recurring series; 'RecurrenceType' (Optional[str]): Type of recurrence pattern. Valid values: RecursDaily, RecursWeekly, RecursMonthly, RecursMonthlyNth, RecursYearly, RecursYearlyNth (case-sensitive); 'RecurrenceInterval' (Optional[int]): Interval between recurring event instances; 'RecurrenceEndDateOnly' (Optional[str]): Recurrence end date in YYYY-MM-DD format (case-sensitive comparison); 'RecurrenceMonthOfYear' (Optional[int]): Month of year for recurrence (1-12); 'RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask' (Optional[int]): Day of week mask for recurrence; 'RecurrenceDayOfMonth' (Optional[int]): Day of month for recurrence (1-31); 'RecurrenceInstance' (Optional[str]): Recurrence instance specification. Valid values: First, Second, Third, Fourth, Last (case-sensitive); 'IsReminderSet' (Optional[bool]): Whether a reminder has been set for this event; 'ReminderDateTime' (Optional[str]): Reminder date and time in ISO 8601 format (case-sensitive comparison). These keys are type-validated when present. Case sensitivity for string comparisons is determined by field metadata: fields marked as case-sensitive, ID fields (type='id' or idLookup=True), and datetime fields (type='datetime') are compared case-sensitively, while other string fields are compared case-insensitively. Additional keys are allowed and will be used for exact field matching when they exist on event records, with case sensitivity determined by their metadata. Keys that are not present in the criteria dict are simply ignored (not used for filtering).

IsAllDayEvent.description: Whether the event is all day.

Name.description: Name of the event to filter by (case-insensitive comparison).

OwnerId.description: ID of the event owner. Compared case-sensitively.

WhoId.description: ID of the related contact or lead associated with the event. Compared case-sensitively.

WhatId.description: ID of the related account, opportunity, campaign, case, or contract. Compared case-sensitively.

Id.description: Unique identifier for the event. Compared case-sensitively.

CreatedDate.description: Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Compared case-sensitively.

SystemModstamp.description: Last modification timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Compared case-sensitively.

deletedDate.description: Deletion timestamp in ISO 8601 format (present only for deleted events). Use to filter DeletedEvents entries. Compared case-sensitively.

ActivityDate.description: Date of the activity in ISO 8601 format (date or dateTime). Compared case-sensitively.

ActivityDateTime.description: Date and time of the activity in ISO 8601 format. Compared case-sensitively.

ReminderDateTime.description: Date and time when the reminder should trigger in ISO 8601 format. Compared case-sensitively.

RecurrenceEndDateOnly.description: End date for the recurrence series in YYYY-MM-DD format. Compared case-sensitively.

DurationInMinutes.description: Duration of the event in minutes.

ShowAs.description: How the event appears in calendar. Valid values: Busy, Free, OutOfOffice, Tentative (case-sensitive).

Type.description: Type of the event. Valid values: Meeting, Call, Email, Other (case-sensitive).

IsChild.description: Whether the event is a child event in a recurring series.

IsGroupEvent.description: Whether the event is a group event involving multiple participants.

GroupEventType.description: Type of group event. Valid values: Group0, Group1 (case-sensitive).

IsRecurrence.description: Whether the event is part of a recurring series.

RecurrenceType.description: Type of recurrence pattern. Valid values: RecursDaily, RecursWeekly, RecursMonthly, RecursMonthlyNth, RecursYearly, RecursYearlyNth (case-sensitive).

RecurrenceInterval.description: Interval between recurring event instances (e.g., every 2 weeks).

RecurrenceMonthOfYear.description: Month of year for recurrence (1-12) for yearly recurrence patterns.

RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask.description: Day of week mask for recurrence (bitmask representing days).

RecurrenceDayOfMonth.description: Day of month for recurrence (1-31) for monthly recurrence patterns.

RecurrenceInstance.description: Recurrence instance specification. Valid values: First, Second, Third, Fourth, Last (case-sensitive).

IsReminderSet.description: Whether a reminder has been set for this event.

name: update_event
description:
Updates an existing event.

This function validates input using the EventUpdateRequest Pydantic model, performs referential
integrity checks on ID fields, auto-calculates DurationInMinutes if not provided, updates
SystemModstamp to current time, and stores the updated event in the database.

To clear a string field, pass an empty string (""). Passing None will leave the field unchanged.

Recurrence Rules:
When updating recurring events, the following validation rules apply:

General Consistency Rules:
- If IsRecurrence is True, RecurrenceType must be provided (minimum requirement).
- If any recurrence field is provided (RecurrenceType, RecurrenceInterval, RecurrenceEndDateOnly, RecurrenceMonthOfYear, RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask, RecurrenceDayOfMonth, or RecurrenceInstance), IsRecurrence must be set to True.
- If RecurrenceType is provided, IsRecurrence must be set to True.

RecurrenceType-Specific Required Fields:
- RecursDaily (daily recurrence): RecurrenceInterval (required, positive integer specifying interval in days), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required, YYYY-MM-DD format).
- RecursWeekly (weekly recurrence): RecurrenceInterval (required, positive integer specifying interval in weeks), RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask (required, bitmask: Sunday=1, Monday=2, Tuesday=4, Wednesday=8, Thursday=16, Friday=32, Saturday=64), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).
- RecursMonthly (monthly on specific day): RecurrenceInterval (required, positive integer specifying interval in months), RecurrenceDayOfMonth (required, 1-31), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).
- RecursMonthlyNth (monthly on Nth weekday, e.g., "second Tuesday"): RecurrenceInterval (required), RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask (required), RecurrenceInstance (required, First/Second/Third/Fourth/Last), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).
- RecursYearly (yearly on specific date): RecurrenceMonthOfYear (required, 1-12), RecurrenceDayOfMonth (required, 1-31), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).
- RecursYearlyNth (yearly on Nth weekday of month, e.g., "third Monday of March"): RecurrenceMonthOfYear (required, 1-12), RecurrenceDayOfWeekMask (required), RecurrenceInstance (required), RecurrenceEndDateOnly (required).
